subject: Social Media
title: Breaking the Bubble
description: A short lesson to help you apply Breaking the Bubble.

hook.text: A man followed 1,000 opposing accounts for a month. He didn't change his mind—he got angrier.

buildup.text: Just showing people opposing views often backfires. It triggers defensiveness, not openness.

discovery.text: Researchers found 'bridging' content—stories showing both sides fairly—reduces polarization.

twist.text: No major platform profits from bridging divides. Conflict drives engagement. Unity is boring.

climax.text: Startups tried balanced feeds. Users engaged less but reported feeling better about the world.

punchline.text: The cure isn't exposure. It's curiosity.

quiz.question: What approach actually helps reduce polarization?
options: Bridging content that fairly shows multiple sides
